name: dsh-kb-reader
description: Philosophy & literature reading desk over the translation-agent book corpus: kb_ask retrieves chapter-anchored evidence passages, kb_verify_quote checks a direct quote verbatim (verbatim / verbatim_normalized / mismatch / not_found), kb_library lists workspaces, corpus size and publication acceptance; read-only, retrieve before answering, cite 《书名》·章节 for every corpus claim. · 本地书库检索台：kb_ask 取带章节定位的原文证据，kb_verify_quote 逐字核验直接引文，kb_library 列工作区、语料规模与发布验收状态；只读工具，先取证再作答，回答逐条标明《书名》·章节出处。
